en.topic_title: Chinese comedian Guo Degang investigated after patriotic song gag

zh.topic_title: Chinese comedian Guo Degang investigated after patriotic song gag

en.topic_title: Chinese comedian Guo Degang investigated after patriotic song gag
en.topic_summary:
A famous Chinese comedian is under investigation, local authorities told AFP on Sunday, after he reportedly poked fun at a patriotic song during a performance.



Chinese comedian Guo Degang. Photo: Kai Tak Sports Park.



The ruling Communist Party maintains tight control over China’s arts scene, and the government has enacted laws in recent years to protect national heroes and symbols from purported slander.



Guo Degang, 53, allegedly improvised part of a 1956 tune about Chinese fighte
